description: This Java class 'SagePayUtil' provides utility methods for constructing payment response maps, building HTTP requests, and parsing HTTP responses related to SagePay payment processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SagePayUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for handling SagePay payment responses, HTTP communication, and response parsing.

methods.name: buildCardAuthorisationPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with authorization response details.

methods.name: buildCardCapturePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with capture response details.

methods.name: buildCardReleasePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with release response details.

methods.name: buildCardVoidPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with void/refund response details.

methods.name: buildCardRefundPaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map with refund response details.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Builds HttpHost object based on SagePay properties or explicit host details.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Parses HttpResponse to extract key-value pairs from response content.

methods.name: getHttpPost
methods.description: Creates an HttpPost object with headers and URL-encoded form parameters.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a default CloseableHttpClient instance.
